Action Sequence Impact - VisuStella MZ
========================================

SUMÁRIO
--------
Plugin Tier 3 que adiciona efeitos visuais de impacto em batalha usando Pixi JS Filters.
Fornece 11 efeitos visuais, Action Sequences IMPACT e INJECT, e configurações automáticas para eventos de combate.

REQUISITOS
----------
- Pixi JS Filters (Tier 0, download separado)
- Core Engine VisuStella MZ
- Battle Core VisuStella MZ
- RPG Maker MZ (não funciona em MV ou anterior)
- Action Sequences são acessadas pelo Battle Core, não por este plugin

EFEITOS VISUAIS (11)
--------------------
1. Bizarro Inversion - Troca azul/vermelho no battlefield. Action Sequence: toggle.
2. Color Break - Chromatic aberration em críticos. Automático + Action Sequence. Params: Intensity, Duration, Easing.
3. Desaturation - Preto e branco. Action Sequence: toggle. (Manu Gaming)
4. Motion Blur - Desfoque em dodges. Automático + Action Sequence (screen/target). Params: Angle, Intensity (0-1), Duration, Easing.
5. Negative Inversion - Inversão de hue. Action Sequence: toggle. (Manu Gaming)
6. Oversaturation - Saturação extrema. Action Sequence: toggle.
7. Shockwave - Ondas de choque em guard. Automático + Action Sequence (point/each target/center). Params: Amplitude, Wavelength, Duration.
8. Motion Trail - Rastro de movimento. Action Sequence only (create/remove). Params: Delay, Duration, Hue, Opacity, Tone.
9. Time Scale - Câmera lenta/rápida. Action Sequence. Params: Scale (1.00=normal). (Manu Gaming)
10. Time Stop - Pausa temporal. Action Sequence. Params: Milliseconds. (Manu Gaming)
11. Zoom Blur - Desfoque radial. Action Sequence only (point/target center). Params: Zoom Strength (0-1), Visible Radius, Duration, Easing.

ACTION SEQUENCES - IMPACT (16 comandos)
----------------------------------------
- IMPACT: Bizarro Inversion (Bizarro?)
- IMPACT: Color Break (Intensity, Duration, Easing Type)
- IMPACT: Desaturation (Desaturate?)
- IMPACT: Motion Blur Screen (Angle, Intensity Rate, Duration, Easing Type)
- IMPACT: Motion Blur Target(s) (Targets, Angle, Intensity Rate, Duration, Easing Type)
- IMPACT: Motion Trail Create (Targets, Delay, Duration, Hue, Starting Opacity, Tone [R,G,B,Gray])
- IMPACT: Motion Trail Remove (Targets)
- IMPACT: Negative Inversion (Negative?)
- IMPACT: Oversaturation (Oversaturate?)
- IMPACT: Shockwave at Point (Point X, Point Y [suporta JS], Amplitude, Wavelength, Duration)
- IMPACT: Shockwave from Each Target(s) (Targets, Target Location, Offset X/Y, Amplitude, Wavelength, Duration)
- IMPACT: Shockwave from Target(s) Center (Targets, Target Location, Offset X/Y, Amplitude, Wavelength, Duration)
- IMPACT: Time Scale (Scale: 1.00=normal)
- IMPACT: Time Stop (Milliseconds: 1000=1s)
- IMPACT: Zoom Blur at Point (Point X/Y, Zoom Strength 0-1, Visible Radius, Duration, Easing Type)
- IMPACT: Zoom Blur at Target(s) Center (Targets, Target Location, Offset X/Y, Zoom Strength 0-1, Visible Radius, Duration, Easing Type)

ACTION SEQUENCES - INJECT (4 comandos)
---------------------------------------
- INJECT: Animation Begin (Targets, Filename [/img/sv_actors/], Horizontal/Vertical Cells, Frame Delay, Smooth Bitmap?, Offset X/Y)
- INJECT: Animation End (Targets)
- INJECT: Animation Pause/Resume (Targets, Pause?)
- INJECT: Wait For Injected Animation (sem parâmetros)

PARÂMETROS DO PLUGIN
---------------------
1. Critical Color Break Settings: Enable/Disable, Intensity, Duration, Easing Type
2. Dodge Motion Blur Settings: Enable/Disable, Intensity Rate (0-1), Duration, Easing Type
3. Guard Shockwave Settings: Enable/Disable, Amplitude, Wavelength, Duration

NOTAS
-----
- Efeitos aplicados ao battlefield afetam sprites mas não UI/pictures externos
- Battle animations podem ou não ser afetadas (configurável)
- Time Scale afeta apenas batalha, para durante input phase e mensagens
- INJECT Animation Begin esconde o sprite original do battler enquanto animação roda
- Spritesheets para INJECT ficam em /img/sv_actors/

RELACIONAMENTO ENTRE ÁREAS
--------------------------
